text:
deploybot: starting staged rollout v2026-07-20-rc1 -> 10% global at 21:00 UTC. monitors: p95, 5xx, deploy-health; change window = 21:00-23:00 UTC. status: IN_PROGRESS
liam: quick check - is the eu-west bump scheduled to 25% at 21:15 or 21:30? release doc shows 15min step but notes ambiguous.
emma: release doc line: \"step durations: 15m -> 15m -> 30m\" which maps to 10%->25%@21:15->50%@21:30. but we should confirm quiet window overlaps with our QA window.
sofia: ops: can we hold 10% until post-change-window checks finish? customer-facing traffic during quiet window is sensitive.
devops_bot: poll: hold until post-window checks? react :+1: hold, :-1: proceed.
liam: +1 hold. we should not advance during the quiet window until sentinels green for 10m.
emma: +1 hold. also recommend pin region eu-west->stable if any p95 spike > +40% during hold.
release_manager: noted. clarification: change window ends 23:00 UTC, but we planned a slow continuous roll after that. if we hold now, update the rollout schedule accordingly.
deploybot: health snapshot at t+60s: p95 baseline, 5xx baseline, no errors. continuing monitoring but holding automatic step until consensus.
devops_bot: votes: 3 hold, 0 proceed. automatic step override disabled.
sofia: good. i'll run a 5m synthesis test across long sequences and chat flows to validate correctness during hold.
liam: also add a guard: if any region p95 > +50% OR 5xx > baseline*3 then immediate rollback to v2026-07-05-stable for affected region.
emma: adding a short release note entry: \"Rollout paused for quiet-window validation; no customer impact observed. Will resume gradual increase after confirmation.\" keep it non-technical.
release_manager: I'll update the public rollout timeline and ping PS for heads-up.
deploybot: audit: action=hold; rollout=v2026-07-20-rc1; reason="manual hold for quiet-window validation"; scheduled_resume=after-confirmation-or-23:05 UTC.
sofia: tests started. will post pass/fail in-thread.
(automated) devops_bot: thread audit: hold triggered by team consensus; resume gated by 10m green sentinels.
liam: thanks team — keep this thread for the go/no-go at resume time.
sofia: test update: +6m, all synth checks pass, no tail increase. ready for a controlled bump to 25% with tightened sentinels.
devops_bot: quickvote: bump to 25% now? react :+1: bump, :-1: wait.
liam: +1 bump
emma: +1 bump with sentinel windows set to 5m
release_manager: +1 bump. updating schedule to reflect hold.
deploybot: resuming staged rollout: 10% -> 25% at 21:18 UTC. sentinels: p95 threshold +30%, 5xx threshold baseline*2. proceeding.
(automated) deploybot: final audit entry: action=resumed_and_bumped; rollout=v2026-07-20-rc1; from=10% to=25%; resume_time=21:18 UTC; note="held for quiet-window validation"
